root.label: Thom Tillis delays Kevin Warsh nomination

events.label: Thom Tillis delays Kevin Warsh nomination

slots.name: Ed Martin nomination status
slots.sentence: A member of the Judiciary Committee, Tillis blocked the nomination of Ed Martin to serve as the U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia in 2025 because of his comments about the January 6 attack on the Capitol.

slots.name: Kevin Warsh nomination status
slots.sentence: After deciding not to run again, Tillis delayed (but did not stop) the nomination of Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve chair, until the Justice Department dropped its criminal investigation of then-Chair Jerome Powell.
